name: FSL Brain Extraction (BET) on FLAIR
summary: Removes non-brain tissue from a FLAIR image with FSL BET (robust centre estimation) and outputs the skull-stripped image and its binary brain mask.
description: Runs FSL bet with -R -m on the FLAIR image using the chosen fractional intensity threshold. Use it before registration or analyses that need a skull-stripped FLAIR image. The output keeps all other files of the input datatype and replaces the image with the masked one. Inspect the mask: if too much or too little brain is removed, adjust fthreshold.

outputs.description: The input FLAIR datatype with its image replaced by the BET brain-extracted image.
Binary brain mask (mask.nii.gz) produced by BET from the FLAIR image.

parameters.description: fractional intensity threshold (0->1); default=0.5; smaller values give larger brain outline estimates
